verdicts.summary: A question notice is routed to steer_active only after the same checks dispatchSteerIntoRun later repeats (running run, running provider turn, live session, active steering, no Stop). Its model selection is pinned to the target run, so the steer cannot fall into the restart path.
verdicts.scenario: I tried to make the steered question restart the parent turn instead of joining it. That would happen if the composer selection differed from the run's selection (selectionMustApplyNow) or if the message had attachments. Neither can happen: modelSelection is the target run's own selection (5837-5840), so selectionChanged is false at 4797; the reactor always sends attachments: [] (DelegatedTaskQuestionReactor.ts:54). forceRestart is therefore false at 4935. Stop racing the routing is caught by stopReachedRun at 5770 and again at 4747. A repeated question dispatch from the run.updated catch-up reuses the same commandId and is deduplicated by the receipt check at 13451-13462.

verdicts.summary: A notification-only retry is now sent as queue_after_active, which passes the notification validation. It reuses the message id, and the reactor can still cancel the resulting queued run by that id. The model-selection mismatch is already finding 0.
verdicts.scenario: Case 1: the steer loses the race while another run is already running on the parent. The retry goes through the delegated_task routing again and may steer into that run. If that steer also loses, the next retry uses a new effect id; each retry is triggered only by a real turn completion, so this cannot loop without bound. Case 2: the question is answered after the retry has queued a run. The reactor finds the queued run by userMessageId === messageId (DelegatedTaskQuestionReactor.ts:114-123) and cancels it. The validation at 5684 accepts queue_after_active, so the retry is no longer rejected as it was before.
